ios.desc:
We know it's harder than ever to be a parent these days. Parenthing articles are now free, you also get all the content for a domain you chose!

After completing the initial screening, we are going to select lessons from our library that are recommended for your child. You'll receive personalized information, exercises, and tests to help you stay positive and in control while keeping parenting skills top of mind! 

Our evidence-based parenting techniques include scripts of exactly what to say and when to say to help you raise a happy, confident kid, as well as word-class summaries of the most important parenting domains. The right advice for your unique kid is here in our easy-to-digest format, which means you can finally stop searching the internet and buying lengthy books to find answers.

FEATURES:

• Short lessons help you understand your child’s development, encourage better behavior, and help you feel more confident as a parent. Get the knowledge of over 100 parenting books in 3 minutes lessons. 

• Custom content for your child (articles, tests, and exercises)

• Domain-specific tests for each topic in the app in order to assess your child's development in specific areas

• Domain-specific exercises for each topic of the app so that you can improve your child's health in specific areas

• Deep library of organized, engaging content allows you to save lessons for quick refreshes

• Search - for easy finding the right parenting information right when you need it the most


LIBRARY INCLUDES:

• BEHAVIORS: Anxiety, biting, disrespect, hitting, interrupting, listening, lying, picky eating, potty talk, sharing, sibling rivalry, tantrums, tattling, and whining

• GUIDES: Bedtime, dinner time, family gatherings, homework, mornings, potty training, school days, screen time, and vacations

• STRENGTHS: Bravery, creativity, helpful, kindness, and resilience.


PERFECT FOR PARENTS WHO:

• Want to enjoy parenting more and to be a more conscious parent, but have limited free time. 

• Are moving out of the baby stage and want to understand their toddler and school-aged kids' behavior and development. 

• Are looking for solutions for “in the moment” problems, like tantrums, not listening, being fearful, and more.


You may purchase an in-app content through an In-App Purchase.
